speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
text: asked the Minister for Transport (a) what actions have been taken against the use of PMDs on minor roads in private landed estates; (b) how many PMD users have been caught for riding on such roads in the past year; and (c) what actions have been taken to ensure that roadside footpaths in such estates are kept clear of obstacles to allow unblocked access for use by PMDs, personal mobility aids and pedestrians.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: However, there are cases where obstruction is caused by residents.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: In such instances, LTA will engage the resident or work with the neighbourhood committee to remove the obstruction.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: Ultimately, it is a joint responsibility of residents and the authorities to ensure that our paths are free of litter and obstruction.
